msg: warning: Variable p is used uninitialized!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): b62bd7b261b.c (BusyBox mdev). Uninitialized value on 'p' at line 31 ('p++'), when def(MDEV_RENAME) AND def(MDEV_RENAME_REGEXP) AND def(MDEV_CONF). 'char *p' declared at line 11 inside nested #ifdef blocks without initialization. Inside #ifdef MDEV_RENAME_REGEXP, '*p = *s' at line 24 dereferences uninitialized p, and 'p++' at line 31 uses the uninitialized pointer. This is the known vbdb UninitializedVariable bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: all three flags are necessary and sufficient.
